pages: Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (GBDT) are a family of machine learning algorithms used for regression, classification, and scoring (rank ordering or probability estimation) tasks Each tree cumulatively contributes evidence to the final prediction by modeling residuals of the previous trees Trees with higher depths include interactions between features, which is useful for feature engineering Each tree with interactions can be viewed as a scoring model that can be linearized by treating tree leaf indices as bins to calculate WOE features that feed into a logistic regression scorecard This deck demonstrates the feature engineering approach in practice ➜ Boosted Tree Interactions to WOE A New Approach to Feature Engineering in Credit Scoring Model 1 Model 2 …

Boosted Tree Interactions to WOE A New Approach to Feature Engineering in Credit Scoring Each tree in the ensemble (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) gets a specific index where the observations lands, here we use a depth of 3 We can evaluate rank-ordering of each tree after converting leaves to WOE to understand which feature interactions have a stand-alone ranking importance (tree_3 has the highest-ranking value) For tree_3 (the highest Gini), we can see that a useful split in index 5 allows to filter out half of the portfolio with just 0.17% default rate obs1 obs2 obs3 obs4 obs5 This view allows us to examine the interactions that can be included in a linear scorecard model alongside main effects

Boosted Tree Interactions to WOE A New Approach to Feature Engineering in Credit Scoring Note that on the test set, we can achieve nearly the same ranking performance with a linear model (main effects + interactions from GBDT) as with XGBoost For this feature engineering pipeline, we used two Python libraries: • xbooster to produce GBDT leaf indices • fastwoe to convert indices to WOE values You can find the notebook with these experiments here: gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb https://github.com/xRiskLab/xBooster https://github.com/xRiskLab/xBooster https://github.com/xRiskLab/fastwoe https://github.com/xRiskLab/fastwoe https://nbviewer.org/github/deburky/boosting-scorecards/blob/main/other_notebooks/gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb https://nbviewer.org/github/deburky/boosting-scorecards/blob/main/other_notebooks/gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb https://nbviewer.org/github/deburky/boosting-scorecards/blob/main/other_notebooks/gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb https://nbviewer.org/github/deburky/boosting-scorecards/blob/main/other_notebooks/gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb https://nbviewer.org/github/deburky/boosting-scorecards/blob/main/other_notebooks/gbdt-leaf-woe.ipynb
